name: Kansen - Clipping Chronicle
source: Set a few days before the initial outbreak of the Kansen Virus in the Tohoku region of Japan. Shibue Akira, Suda, Ashina Rui, and Kiyohara Riri are on their way to the Summer training camp facility where they are training for the sport's nationals hosted in Autumn. The Summer training camp will also be hosting participants from other schools located in the Tohoku region. On the way there, they see an abandoned car which is only one of the mysterious events leading up to the survival of their lives from the people infected with the Kansen Virus.
translation: 故事发生在日本东北地区关线病毒首次爆发前几天。涉江明、须田、芦名瑠和清原莉莉正在前往夏季训练营的路上，他们正在为秋季举办的全国代表队进行训练。夏季训练营还将接待来自东北地区其他学校的参与者。在去那里的路上，他们看到了一辆被遗弃的汽车，这只是感染了关森病毒的人得以幸存的神秘事件之一。
